items.title: Eddie Alley interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: In fact I’ve got a picture of me and Tony Bennett at home I should have brought it.

ctx.x: And she liked somebody down to earth. These guys might try to put her on, and so, here’s another story though. There’s two guys that used to come in the place every night, two guys, and sit in the corner. And they said they were songwriters. I said don’t pay any attention to them, I said that’s nice. So about five years later, when Tony Bennett had that song “I Left My Heart in San Francisco,” I found out these are the guys that wrote the song. If I had known that I would have shaked hands with them.
See if you could get on the record.
